What went wrong, most often

From the 39 submissions to Condition Test, and everything marked before it. If one of these is you, it is on your card below.

9Fully correct

Every sample and every hidden test, boundaries included. That is the standard.

2Did not compile at all

One of them was a single character. Compile and run once yourself before you submit — it is the cheapest mark on the paper.

12Printed nothing for some inputs

An if-chain with no final else simply falls off the end and prints nothing. Every chain you write should end with one.

4A mistake 4 of you shared

Right structure, but no upper bound on the day: they check a>12 for the month and never that a<=30. Fails only 31 12, where 31 cannot be a day because every month has 30. One missing bound on an otherwise sound solution.

3A mistake 3 of you shared

Three different failures that happen to score the same. Shantonu calls scanf again INSIDE the branches with a bogus format string. Al Noman wrote if("a=1||2||3...") — a string literal, so always true. Nahinul tests a%1!=0, never true for any integer.

31 12The input that beat most people

13 of the 37 programs that ran got this one wrong. It is the kind of case the samples never show you.
